headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 31, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Anthony Kay earning the win. Edgar Quero led the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs. The Washington Nationals snapped the San Diego Padres' winning streak with a 9-4 victory, while the Baltimore Orioles secured a 6-5 win over the Toronto Blue Jays.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Konnor Griffin (Pittsburgh Pirates, right elbow strain), Bailey Ober (Minnesota Twins, right elbow inflammation), Angel Zerpa (Milwaukee Brewers, left forearm tightness), Craig Kimbrel (Tampa Bay Rays, right wrist strain), Harrison Bader (San Francisco Giants, left plantar fasciitis), Welinton Herrera (Colorado Rockies, left elbow inflammation), Luis Severino (Athletics, right shoulder strain), and Pierce Johnson (Cincinnati Reds, right elbow inflammation).

The Detroit Tigers traded RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for LHP Juanmi Vasquez, while the Washington Nationals acquired LHP Carson Palmquist from the Colorado Rockies for cash. The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for future considerations and international bonus pool money. The Cincinnati Reds traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley.

top_news.title: **Tigers Fall to White Sox in Dominant 7-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Anthony Kay earning the win. Edgar Quero led the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Nationals in 9-4 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 9-4 victory over the San Diego Padres, snapping their winning streak. Manny Machado led the Padres' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall Short in Texas**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dropped a 6-7 decision to the Texas Rangers in a closely contested matchup. Carter Jensen led the Royals' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Orioles Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 6-5 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Albert Suárez earning the win. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. led the Blue Jays with 4 hits, while Brandon Young pitched 6.2 innings, striking out 7 and allowing 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Fall to Orioles in 5-9 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays suffered a tough loss to the Baltimore Orioles, with Nathan Lukes and Ernie Clement contributing to the Blue Jays' offense. Gunnar Henderson and Pete Alonso led the Orioles' charge with multiple hits.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall Short in Nation's Capital**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals edged the San Diego Padres 4-2, handing them a tough loss. Impact players on both sides included Jackson Merrill, James Wood, Luis García Jr., CJ Abrams, and Keibert Ruiz.

top_news.title: **Pirates Place Griffin on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Pittsburgh Pirates shortstop Konnor Griffin has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right elbow strain. Griffin's status change comes as the Pirates continue their 2026 season.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire Left-Handed Pitcher in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers made a move on May 27, 2026, acquiring left-handed pitcher Juanmi Vasquez in a trade. Vasquez joins the Tigers after being dealt from the Toronto Blue Jays.
